pick.name: Penpot
pick.what: Open-source Figma-class design tool (web, self-hostable) with an MCP server
pick.why: Free with no tool limits, SVG/CSS-native output, an MCP server without Figma's call caps, and no lock-in.
pick.free_limits: Professional plan $0 per user, 'no limits on tools'; Unlimited $7/editor/mo (cap $175/mo)

alts.name: Figma
alts.why: Pay-later pick when clients/designers hand you Figma files; free MCP is nearly useless.
alts.free_limits: Starter: 150 AI credits/day up to 500/mo; MCP up to 20 tool calls/month on Starter (and on View/Collab seats). Professional Full seat $16/mo (MCP 200 calls/day, 10/min), Dev seat $12/mo

alts.name: Google Stitch
alts.what: AI-native design canvas (Google Labs) with MCP/SDK and DESIGN.md
alts.why: Free AI-first canvas; strong for generating many screen variants fast.
alts.free_limits: Free; exact quota unverified (third-party reports conflict)

decision: Penpot is the strongest free canvas and its MCP lets Claude Code read and write designs without Figma's 20-calls/month Starter cap. Switch to Figma Professional ($16/mo) when collaborators work in Figma or you need its plugin/community ecosystem.
details: Most real design work for this user should start in Claude Design or Stitch and be refined in code; the canvas is for brand assets, flows and handoff.

verify.note: Professional $0, Unlimited $7/editor capped at $175/mo, v2.18.5 (26 Oct 2026). Official MCP exists (help.penpot.app/mcp; local: npx @penpot/mcp@stable).
